_comment: Attaches photos to the 2022 catalogue. That feed only names image files, whose host (secretpleasurez.com/imgs) is dead, but it carries UPCs. The 2023 feed has live CloudFront image URLs keyed by UPC. var/feeds/upc-image-map.csv is the join of the two: product reference -> image URL. Rebuild it with tools/dev/build-upc-image-map.py if either feed changes.
